properties.description:
THE 22nd SERVED SKILL, and the second about doing work rather than describing it. Anthony, 2026-08-28: a `/rca` that walks the design systematically and returns possible root causes — "trying to stem the agent's tendency to be over-confident in identifying an issue without doing proper RCA."

⭐ WHY A SKILL WHEN THE RULE ALREADY EXISTED, and this is the whole design. `rule:an-issue-is-root-caused-then-pinned-by-a-test-then-fixed` already carried the ordered method in Anthony's own words, is `enforced: false`, and its own text records that the fix which prompted it skipped the load-bearing step. A RULE is read once at handshake and states an intention; a SKILL is pulled at the moment of the work and states an action. The same distinction `req:a-discipline-is-delivered-at-the-tool-not-in-a-catalogue` already makes for conventions.

⭐⭐ THE PART THAT MAKES IT MORE THAN A CHECKLIST, and it came from Anthony correcting a first draft that had swung too far toward guiding the agent: THE DESIGN IS A CAUSE-GENERATOR. Step ③ does not say "think of three causes" — that yields two real candidates and a filler written to satisfy the instruction. It walks NINE BONES, each answered by a call rather than by memory: precedent (`search_design` on the raw error), intent (SATISFIES, and a requirement still `proposed`), allocation (`granularity_report` — a file realizing many capabilities is where defects concentrate), contract (`seam_report`), implementation (`reconcile_artifacts`), assurance (`coverage_report`, `evidence_report`), change (`propagate_from`), governance (`detect_defects`, CONTRADICTS), and staleness (`invalidated_findings`).

⭐ AND WHERE THE PROJECT IS A CODEBASE, THE ARTIFACT LAYER IS THE BRIDGE: symptom → the capability it belongs to → the artifacts that REALIZE it → the actual files. That turns "something is wrong in the system" into a bounded set of source files each carrying a stated reason, which is a better starting point than a repository-wide search.

THE LOAD-BEARING STEP IS ④: name the measurement that would REFUTE each candidate. A measurement that CONFIRMS the favourite is not evidence — almost any observation is consistent with a plausible cause, which is what makes it plausible. If two candidates predict the same observation, the skill requires saying so rather than picking the likelier-sounding one.

⚠️ ITS EXAMPLES ARE FROM THE SESSION THAT BUILT IT, not invented. Step ⑤ ("a call that completed is not a call that worked") records a search timed at 0.08s and reported as fast — the process had come up on a degraded surface, refused the tool and exited, so a true number measured a refusal. Step ② records a root cause that sat in the graph, findable by its error string, while a session re-derived it from scratch and wrote "second occurrence, so it is a reliable pattern"; that issue reached eleven occurrences before anyone searched.

⚠️ HONEST LIMIT, WRITTEN INTO THE SKILL RATHER THAN OUT OF IT: the graph GENERATES candidates and never confirms them — a candidate the design produced is exactly as unproven as one somebody imagined — and it can only offer candidates about what it MODELS. An unmodelled file, an undeclared seam and an unwritten requirement all look like silence. `coverage_report` is what tells absence-of-cause from absence-of-modelling, and on this project it has named 136 files no Artifact points at.
properties.name: A failure gets its causes generated from the design, and the leading one has to survive a refuting measurement
